review_notes: The target file has one theorem, `bundleMapClass_comp_left`. It is a computation lemma, not a function with companion preservation lemmas. I read the related definitions in Skein/BundleMapClasses.lean: `bundleMapCompose`, `bundleMapClass`, `bundleMapClass_refl`, `bundleMapClass_comp` and `bundleMapClass_congr`. I also checked the uses in Skein/MonoidalStruct.lean. `bundleMapClass` with its refl, comp and tensor lemmas could in principle be bundled as a functor from the groupoid of finite types and equivalences into the skein category. That would be a change to a different file. It would also need new category-level infrastructure, because the `Fin n` types sit at the level of `ℕ` arities and `HomSpace f.val (n + m)` is indexed by arity sums. I found no concrete use in this file that would gain from it. The target lemma only restates `bundleMapCompose` at the class level. It uses `Equiv`, which is already the standard bundled type, so I did not flag it. The remaining uncertainty is whether a functor from `Fin`-equivalences to the skein category already exists elsewhere. I did not trace the category instances in SkeinCatInstance.lean in detail.
